business_summary: CONMED Corporation, a medical technology company, develops, manufactures, and sells devices and equipment for surgical procedures. The company offers orthopedic surgery products, including BioBrace, TruShot with Y-Knot All-In-One Soft Tissue Fixation System, Y-knot All-Suture Anchors, and Agro Knotless Suture Anchors, which provide clinical solutions to orthopedic surgeons for the augmentation and repair of soft tissue injuries, as well as powered resection instruments, fluid management and visualization systems, and related single-use products that enable surgeons to perform minimally invasive sports medicine surgeries. It also provides battery-powered, autoclavable, large, and small bone power tool systems for use in orthopedic, arthroscopic, oral/maxillofacial, podiatric, spinal, and cardiothoracic surgeries under the Hall surgical brand name. In addition, the company offers general surgery products, such as clinical insufflation systems under the AirSeal brand; smoke removal devices under the Buffalo Filter brand; endomechanical products, including the Anchor1 line of tissue retrieval bags, trocars, suction irrigation devices, graspers, scissors, and dissectors used in minimally invasive surgeries; and electrosurgical solutions comprising monopolar and bipolar generators, argon beam coagulation generators, handpieces, smoke management systems, and other accessories. Further, it provides endoscopic technologies, including therapeutic and diagnostic products for use in gastroenterology procedures; and products to treat diseases of dilation, hemostasis, biliary, stricture management, and infection prevention, as well as ECG electrodes, EEG electrodes, and cardiac defibrillation pads. The company markets its products directly to hospitals, surgery centers, and other healthcare institutions, as well as through medical specialty distributors. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Largo, Florida.
business_summary_ko: 의료 기술 회사인 CONMED Corporation은 수술 절차용 장치 및 장비를 개발, 제조 및 판매합니다. 회사는 BioBrace, Y-Knot 올인원 연조직 고정 시스템을 갖춘 TruShot, Y-knot All-Suture Anchors 및 Agro Knotless Suture Anchors를 포함한 정형외과 수술 제품을 제공합니다. 이 제품들은 정형외과 의사에게 연조직 손상의 확대 및 복구를 위한 임상 솔루션을 제공할 뿐만 아니라 전동 절제 장비, 수액 관리 및 시각화 시스템, 그리고 외과의사가 최소 침습 스포츠 의학 수술을 수행할 수 있도록 하는 관련 일회용 제품도 제공합니다. 또한 Hall 수술 브랜드 이름으로 정형외과, 관절경, 구강/악안면, 족부, 척추 및 심장흉부 수술에 사용할 수 있는 배터리 구동식, 오토클레이브 가능, 크고 작은 뼈 전동 공구 시스템을 제공합니다. 또한 이 회사는 AirSeal 브랜드로 임상 주입 시스템과 같은 일반 수술 제품을 제공합니다. Buffalo Filter 브랜드의 연기 제거 장치; Anchor1 조직 회수 백 라인, 투관침, 흡인 관개 장치, 그래퍼, 가위 및 최소한의 수술에 사용되는 절개기를 포함한 기계 내 제품
